description: Report what happened when you sent: `bounced` or `delivered`, 1 to 100 addresses per call. A bounce you report makes your later email_verify checks of that address come back invalid (reason `reported_bounce`); a delivered report on a catch-all address raises its score. Returns `stored`. Free.

outcomes.description: Each address and what happened when you sent to it.

name: email_outcomes_report
title: Report Email Outcomes
